profile.title: Profile
profile.deleteConfirmBody: Saved measurements and your consent will be erased from this device. This cannot be undone.

disclaimer.screening: Educational prototype. Results are experimental, may be inaccurate, and are not validated for medical use. Do not use them for diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decisions.

consent.subtitle: Home
consent.heroBody: Experimental academic project. Image analysis and estimates are not validated yet; results may be inaccurate.
consent.deviceBody: Photos are never uploaded or leave your phone. The calculation runs on your device.
consent.privacyBody: No cloud storage and no third-party access.
consent.screeningBody: Not validated for medical use and must not be used for diagnosis, treatment, or health decisions. This consent does not authorize storing or reusing photos for research or training.
consent.termsBody: To ensure safe and ethical use, confirm the following two premises before continuing:
consent.screeningSuffix: and is not a medical tool or for diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decisions.
consent.processingSuffix: to try experimental learning features when available.

result.subtitle: Result
result.meaningBody: Your silhouette falls in a reference band. BMI and visual projections do not distinguish lean muscle from fat tissue: it is a preventive starting point for your tracking.
